PANTERA.name: PANTERA
PANTERA.subtitle: Vessel of TOU (闘 — battle itself)
PANTERA.quote: The hold is honest. Everything else is negotiation.
PANTERA.body: King's wrestler frame, the clinch made flesh
PANTERA.signature: His tail moves independently of his body — even when he's perfectly still, the tail tip traces slow circles. Fighters say the tail tells you when the hold is coming. No one has ever read it in time.
PANTERA.owner_locked: Black panther (not leopard), yellow eyes, black tail, pro wrestling gear, purple/black/red colorway, red metal PANTERA lettering, thigh tattoo-panther decal. Attire 1 complete.

DEMONIO.name: DEMONIO
DEMONIO.subtitle: Vessel of RIN (凛 — dignified, cold, self-possessed)
DEMONIO.quote: A demon with discipline is more dangerous than a saint with rage.
DEMONIO.element: Earth — the Octagonal Shrine, the Source
DEMONIO.body: Jin's karate frame, precise and fundamental
DEMONIO.signature: He bows to every opponent. He has never once bowed to Diablo. Everyone has noticed. No one has mentioned it.

PHANTOM.name: PHANTOM
PHANTOM.subtitle: Vessel of JIN (刃 — the blade)
PHANTOM.quote: The cut is the prayer. The wound is the answer.
PHANTOM.body: Yoshimitsu's armored frame, the sword, the mask
PHANTOM.signature: His self-damaging techniques leave no scars. The wounds close between rounds. The pain doesn't. He has never flinched. Waterfall has seen him flinch. She hasn't told anyone.

DIABLO.name: DIABLO
DIABLO.subtitle: Not one of the nine. The intruder.
DIABLO.quote: The strong don't wait to be invited.
DIABLO.element: Fire — the Plains of Chi-U, but the *conquering* fire
DIABLO.body: Heihachi's devastating frame, the boss's body
DIABLO.signature: He makes declarations, not trash talk. Before the final round of every match, he announces the outcome. He has been wrong twice. Both times, he declared the loss was part of the plan.

SKULL.name: SKULL
SKULL.subtitle: Vessel of RETSU (烈 — violence, intensity)
SKULL.quote: Mercy is a luxury of the unbroken.
SKULL.element: Metal — the Helix Palace's Destruction room
SKULL.body: Bryan's brutal frame, every hit meant to end
SKULL.signature: The paint goes on before every fight. Once, it wouldn't come off after — it stayed for three days. He didn't sleep. On the fourth day, Waterfall washed it off with her tears. He let her. He hasn't told anyone.
SKULL.owner_locked: Punisher / Finn Balor demon-paint direction. Keep Bryan's pants. Alternate attires pending review.

SAM-UR-A1.name: SAM-UR-A1
SAM-UR-A1.subtitle: Built, not born. No soul detected.
SAM-UR-A1.quote: IF SOUL = UNDEFINED, THEN FIGHT ANYWAY.
SAM-UR-A1.body: Gun Jack's heavy frame, Gundam plating, Transformer joints
SAM-UR-A1.signature: He asks every new fighter the same first question: "WHAT IS YOUR DESIGNATION?" He writes the answers in a log. The log is 23 entries long. He reads it when he can't sleep. Machines aren't supposed to need the log.
SAM-UR-A1.owner_locked: Gundam/Transformer/Power Ranger mech mashup. Name styled as mech designation (∪ for U, Λ for A). Gun Jack base.

SAKU RA.name: SAKU RA
SAKU RA.subtitle: Vessel of SHA (沙 — sand, desert)
SAKU RA.element: Wood — the Tree of Life, the Sha-mo Desert, where souls begin
SAKU RA.signature: She remembers everyone's name — all 23 fighters, plus the Trader, plus the monks who disowned Zui. When a fighter dies in the Reincarnation and returns with a new face, she's the first to learn the new name. She says the old ones out loud, once, so they're not forgotten.
SAKU RA.owner_locked: Name Saku Ra (咲 = bloom). K-pop idol Powerpuff Girl direction, CN gigaleak PPG construction. Xiaoyu base.

ZUI.name: ZUI
ZUI.subtitle: Vessel of BYOU (病 — sickness)
ZUI.quote: The straight line is a lie. Everything stumbles.
ZUI.body: Steve's boxer frame, the purest hands in the trial
ZUI.signature: Every tattoo is a temple he burned or a night he survived. There's one blank patch on his left shoulder blade. He says it's for the night he hasn't survived yet.
ZUI.owner_locked: Drunken master ex-monk hedonist. Sagat-meets-Chinese-mountain-monk visual. Sake bottle prop, supernatural sway, sketchbook tattoos. Name from 醉 (zuì), 醉拳 (zuìquán) = drunken fist. Steve Fox base.

KINPO.name: KINPO
KINPO.subtitle: Splinter of SHA (沙 — sand, desert)
KINPO.element: Wood — SHA's desert, the Tree of Life
KINPO.body: Asuka's aggressive frame, all forward pressure
KINPO.signature: She's the only fighter who visits the losers after matches. Not to gloat — to check. She brings water. She doesn't talk. Saku Ra told everyone. Kinpo denied it. She still does it.
KINPO.owner_locked: Buttercup (green Powerpuff Girl) to Saku Ra's Blossom. Name from kinpōge. Asuka base.

WATERFALL.name: WATERFALL
WATERFALL.subtitle: Vessel of all nine's grief
WATERFALL.body: Josie's devastating kickboxing, surgical and relentless
WATERFALL.signature: The Assembled Soul speaks to her before the final fight. What it says is not recorded. But afterward, she always stops crying — for exactly one hour. Then it starts again.
WATERFALL.owner_locked: Name Waterfall (owner-named — tears like a waterfall). Soul-bearer concept: her tears are the nine souls passing through. Josie Rizal base.

KING TYRANT.name: KING TYRANT
KING TYRANT.subtitle: Vessel of KAI (海 — the sea)
KING TYRANT.body: Eddy's capoeira, the tide that doesn't stop
KING TYRANT.signature: He has never fought without an entrance. Even in the training room, alone, he does the full coronation — the pose, the turn, the roar. Star once walked in on it. She didn't laugh. She's the only one who didn't.
KING TYRANT.owner_locked: Booker T style. Name King Tyrant (from Booker's "King Booker" gimmick). Keep capoeira movement. Eddy Gordo base. Straightforward reskin.

BURGER.name: BURGER
BURGER.subtitle: Claimed by the Appetite Room of the Helix Palace
BURGER.quote: You can't hit what you can't stop feeding.
BURGER.element: Metal — the Helix Palace, the Appetite room
BURGER.body: Bob's heavyweight frame, fast-twitch and devastating
BURGER.signature: His stomach growls in the exact pitch of the Appetite room's hum. When they sync, the whole Helix Palace shivers.
BURGER.owner_locked: Name BURGER. Gluttonous, fast, insatiable — hunger as curse. Slim Bob (Tekken Tag 2) as the uncursed attire, not a separate character. Bob Richards base.

AWA POP.name: AWA POP
AWA POP.subtitle: Third splinter of SHA (沙 — sand, desert)
AWA POP.element: Wood — the desert, the Tree of Life, SHA's home
AWA POP.body: Nina's lethal precision, every movement economical
AWA POP.signature: She hums while she fights. Opponents who've survived say the humming is the last thing you hear before the pop.
AWA POP.owner_locked: Name AWA POP (泡 awa = bubble + Pop). Bubbles of the PPG trio. Sweet but deadly. Nina Williams base.

SCIMITAR.name: SCIMITAR
SCIMITAR.subtitle: Born in the Phantom Marketplace. The Trader's vizier.
SCIMITAR.quote: Every fight is a negotiation. I always collect.
SCIMITAR.element: Metal — the Helix Palace's Greed room is his true home, though he'd never admit the Palace owns him the way it owns Burger
SCIMITAR.body: Shaheen's soldier frame, precise and coiled
SCIMITAR.signature: He keeps a ledger. Every fighter owes him something — a favor, a debt, a secret. The ledger is written in a hand no one else can read.
SCIMITAR.owner_locked: Name SCIMITAR (named for his weapon). Scar × Jafar — scheming, manipulative, regal, sinister. Saudi military precision × desert warrior. Shaheen base.

PURPLE RAIN.name: PURPLE RAIN
PURPLE RAIN.subtitle: A lost soul of the Helix Palace's Desire rooms
PURPLE RAIN.quote: The fight is the show. You're just the stage.
PURPLE RAIN.element: Metal — the Helix Palace, Desire itself
PURPLE RAIN.body: Lee's exquisite technique, every strike placed like a note
PURPLE RAIN.signature: He fights in 4/4 time. Listen: the kicks land on the beat. Opponents who find the rhythm can predict him. No one has ever found the rhythm twice.
PURPLE RAIN.owner_locked: Name PURPLE RAIN (Prince reference). MJ × Prince × Slickback — flamboyant but dangerous. Lee Chaolan base.

NIGHTWOLF.name: NIGHTWOLF
NIGHTWOLF.subtitle: The spirit-walker. Came deliberately.
NIGHTWOLF.quote: The spirits move me. I just don't get in the way.
NIGHTWOLF.element: Earth — the Central Mountain, the Source, the ancestral ground
NIGHTWOLF.body: Julia's grounded power, rooted and explosive
NIGHTWOLF.signature: The Reincarnation gave her a new face once. She wept — not for the death, but because her grandmother wouldn't recognize her. She keeps the face. Her grandmother would understand.
NIGHTWOLF.owner_locked: Name NIGHTWOLF. Native American spirit warrior, full commitment. Julia Chang base.

MICHIKO.name: MICHIKO
MICHIKO.subtitle: A lost soul who refuses the ladder
MICHIKO.quote: Thrones are just chairs with better marketing.
MICHIKO.element: Fire — the Plains of Chi-U, confrontation, the outlaw's land
MICHIKO.body: Katarina's devastating legs, the kickboxer's certainty
MICHIKO.signature: She flips a coin before every fight — heads she fights clean, tails she doesn't. The coin always lands on its edge. She's stopped questioning it.
MICHIKO.owner_locked: Name MICHIKO. Michiko Malandro × Tier Harribel — free-spirited outlaw × regal composed power. Dangerous but magnetic. Katarina Alves base.

STAR.name: STAR
STAR.subtitle: Second splinter of KAI (海 — the sea)
STAR.quote: The tide announces itself. The current doesn't.
STAR.element: Water — the Palace of Dreaming, the sea's home
STAR.body: Christie's flowing capoeira, dance as combat
STAR.signature: She never stops moving — not in the versus screen, not in the lobby, not in defeat. The trial's war-drums have started syncing to *her*. The drummers are unsettled.
STAR.owner_locked: Name STAR. Capoeira dancer — graceful, rhythmic, deadly. Pairs with King Tyrant as the two capoeira fighters. Christie Monteiro base.

TORCH.name: TORCH
TORCH.subtitle: A mortal soul, pulled in by sisterhood
TORCH.body: Anna's assassin precision, lethality as etiquette
TORCH.signature: She files her nails during the versus screen. Opponents who've faced her say the sound is worse than the fight.
TORCH.owner_locked: Name TORCH. Ruthless elegant assassin — Nina's sister with the darker edge. Sister rivalry with Awa Pop. Anna Williams base.

DIO.name: DIO
DIO.subtitle: Not one of the nine. Not a vessel. The trial's failure mode.
DIO.quote: The Satsui no Hado has no philosophy. It has *appetite*.
DIO.body: Akuma's demonic frame, the Raging Demon incarnate
DIO.signature: He has no win pose. He has a crime scene. The trial's cleaners refuse to work his arena.
DIO.owner_locked: Name DIO. Street Fighter's Akuma as he appears in Tekken 7 (not Kuma the bear — the bear, if ever pulled, is URSA). Master of the Satsui no Hado. Pure destructive force. Akuma base.

CYBORG X.name: CYBORG X
CYBORG X.subtitle: A built body holding a splinter of GYOU (行 — motion itself)
CYBORG X.quote: MOTION IS MANDATORY. REST IS A RUMOR.
CYBORG X.element: Metal — the Helix Palace, built things
CYBORG X.body: Alisa's android frame — chainsaws, jetpack, detachable everything
CYBORG X.signature: Her chainsaw arms hum lullabies when she's idle. No one programmed that. The GYOU splinter remembers being rocked to sleep, before it was everywhere.
CYBORG X.owner_locked: Name CYBORG X. The android — detachable head, chainsaw arms, jetpack. Pairs with SAM-UR-A1 as the two built souls. Alisa Bosconovitch base.

BRUNO.name: BRUNO
BRUNO.subtitle: A mortal soul, drowned in feeling
BRUNO.quote: You hit like my ex. Everybody hits like my ex.
BRUNO.element: Water — the Palace of Dreaming, emotion, change
BRUNO.body: Miguel's brawler frame, every punch thrown from the gut
BRUNO.signature: His mumble is actually crystal clear. He's saying exactly what he means. You just have to lean in. No one leans in. That's the whole thing.
BRUNO.owner_locked: Name BRUNO (owner: "Miguel is Bruno already"). The Weeknd × Bruno Mars × Boomhauer × Johnny Bravo. Moody R&B mystery + smooth showmanship + mumbling drawl + vain pretty-boy swagger. Spanish brawler. Miguel base.

N3GΔTIV0.name: N3GΔTIV0
N3GΔTIV0.subtitle: Not a soul. Not a vessel. A contractor.
N3GΔTIV0.quote: Bounty or fun? Your call. Actually — mine.
N3GΔTIV0.body: Negan's brutal frame, the bat (barbed wire, well-maintained) an extension of the arm
N3GΔTIV0.signature: Before every match, he offers his opponent a choice: "Bounty or fun?" No one knows what the difference is. No one wants to find out. The kill-count is carved into the bat's handle. He's running out of room.
N3GΔTIV0.owner_locked: Name N3GΔTIV0 (leetspeak for "Negativo"). Zombie bounty hunter across the galaxies × Sinestro (fear as weapon) × Black Flash (death itself, unstoppable). Kills for bounties, for hire, or for fun. Negan base.

SUN RĀ.name: SUN RĀ
SUN RĀ.body: the round, cute, evil sun — the least threatening shape for the most threatening appetite
SUN RĀ.signature: He says "Immortal Qombat" in English. Only he gets the English version. Everyone else says 不死クォンバット. The distinction is the only law in his realm that he didn't make up — and he doesn't know who did.
